why: A delay flows from flightTo[i] to flightFrom[i], so build directed edges in that direction and start one BFS from all initially delayed flights at once; everything it reaches is delayed.
hints: Which way does a delay travel along a dependency pair? Draw the arrow before writing any code.
Edge flightTo[i] -> flightFrom[i]. Put all initially delayed flights in the queue together (multi-source) and mark everything reachable.
Adjacency list, visited array of size flightNodes + 1, BFS from the deduplicated delayed list, then output visited IDs in ascending order by scanning 1..flightNodes. O(V + E).
pitfalls: Reversing the edge direction gives the wrong set (example 2 shows the direction).
Repeated delayed IDs or repeated edges must not produce duplicates; use a visited array.
Cycles are possible in the dependency data; mark nodes when enqueued so the BFS terminates.
